deployment-probes.json.description: Machine-readable deployment probes for transport- and operator-posture requirements that are not object-model conformance vectors.

probe.success_condition: for high-security or sovereign profile claims, the completed handshake negotiated TLS group X25519MLKEM768; a peer that does not offer that group is rejected rather than downgraded

cases.name: mention_selector
assertions: selector resolution binds the persisted mention subject_id to the agent DID
controller, slug and original text are audit metadata only
slug changes do not rewrite historical mention targets
ambiguous or unavailable selector claims fail closed

cases.name: ceiling_tighten
assertions: Circle and Strand participation ceilings may only drop bits from their parent
a child that enables act_on_behalf below a disabled parent bit is rejected
a Strand that re-enables a Circle-disabled third-party mention bit is rejected

cases.name: effective_intersection
assertions: effective participation is the bitwise meet of ceiling and controller selection
reply grants materialize only when the effective reply bit is true
act-on-behalf is not granted when the ceiling disables it
tightening the ceiling revokes previously materialized reply grants
unknown or stale ceiling source fails closed to no effective participation

cases.name: selection_within_ceiling
assertions: controller selection must be a subset of the effective ceiling
selection that enables third-party mention above the ceiling is rejected
rejected selections create no capability grants

cases.name: session_overlay
assertions: session scope_details.participation entries are isomorphic to agent_participation_entry
the overlay is a behavior contract and not an authorization boundary
missing backing capability grant still fails the runtime operation

cases.name: third_party_mention_gate
assertions: when accept_third_party_mention is false, non-controller mentions fan out to no agent delivery artifacts
the controller's own mention still delivers
enabling third-party mention later is non-retroactive
subsequent third-party mentions deliver only after the effective bit is true

cases.name: sidecar_ensure_idempotent
assertions: ensure operation id remains ck.self.agent.sidecar_thread.command.ensure
ensure capability action matches the operation id
sidecar profile id remains ck.profile.agent_sidecar_thread.v1

cases.name: sidecar_eligibility_states
assertions: paused agents fail sidecar ensure with agent_paused
deactivated agents fail sidecar ensure with agent_deactivated
default home policy remains context_realm_preferred

cases.name: sidecar_existence_privacy
assertions: callers without sidecar ensure capability receive sidecar_create_denied
sidecar existence is not disclosed via a not_found branch

cases.name: sidecar_multi_agent_publish
assertions: ensure, write, and publish capability actions all remain sidecar-thread scoped
the sidecar capability action trio contains no duplicates

cases.name: agent_provision
assertions: agent provision operation id remains ck.self.agent.command.provision
agent provision capability action matches the operation id
agent grants marked effective_after_first_authorized_key remain inactive before key pairing
missing accountability grants fail with accountability_gr
